title: Finite positive-mass tube lower-bound interface and coarse scaling boundary
question: Given the unchanged R-464/R-465 finite Gibbs comparison, what exact lower-bound contract follows when a measurable positive-volume branch tube and an energy ceiling are supplied?
method: Preserve the existing A1/A6/A7 fixed-floor functional, T-054 forward owner order, T-059/T-061 inverse locks, and all promotion firewalls.
Use the R-465 radial comparison only as an upper bound for the actual finite correlated partition function.
Define an owner-neutral box tube B_N=c_N+[-delta,delta]^d and derive its positive-volume Boltzmann numerator from a supplied energy ceiling.
Combine the numerator lower bound with the partition upper bound to obtain an explicit finite Gibbs-mass lower-bound budget in log form.
Audit fixed half-width and ceiling fixtures in independent, hostile, integrated, and Lean lanes; do not call the fixture source-owned or uniform.
decision_scope: T0 finite conditional Gibbs-mass lower-bound interface; no source-owned branch, uniform probability, entropy density, tightness, continuum, physical, QFT, Yang--Mills, or mass-gap inference
finding: For every declared finite cutoff and beta, a measurable box tube with positive half-width and a valid energy ceiling has Gibbs mass at least vol(B_N)*exp(-beta*E_tube)/Z_upper_N. The log budget is finite but decreases strictly over the owner-neutral fixtures, so a later branch-relative entropy/Jacobian compensator and uniform owner data are indispensable.
decision_reason: This is a nonredundant consequence of the R-464/R-465 boundary: it supplies the exact quantitative interface needed once an owner supplies a real tube, while exposing why the earlier full-dimensional comparison cannot itself close uniform branch mass.
boundary: The box and energy ceiling are synthetic owner-neutral fixtures. No source-owned active embedding, actual A1 tube ceiling, cutoff-uniform estimate, entropy/Jacobian control, tightness, floor removal, continuum, physical branch, Pre-A, Sector A, QFT, Yang--Mills, or mass-gap result follows.
evidence_level: T0 finite conditional Gibbs-mass lower-bound interface
assumptions: The fixed-cutoff R-464 sextic comparison and R-465 radial partition upper envelope are valid.
The later owner supplies a measurable tube and a pointwise energy ceiling on it.
The half-width and ceiling fixtures used here are declared audit inputs rather than fitted or physical values.
missing_assumptions: A source-owned active-branch embedding and positive-mass tube tied to R-461/R-463.
An actual correlated partition normalization and cutoff/volume-uniform upper and lower comparison pair.
A branch-relative entropy/Jacobian compensator, tightness, floor removal, and ordered continuum limits.
A source-owned Q3LOCK dynamics, physical branch, QFT/Yang--Mills identity, and mass-gap bridge.

adversarial_review.check: Could the d-dimensional box volume lose a coordinate?
adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED: exact (2*delta)^d is retained and hostile-tested.

adversarial_review.check: Could delta be used as the side length instead of 2*delta?
adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED: the side identity is explicit.

adversarial_review.check: Could beta*E_tube be omitted from the numerator lower bound?
adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED: the hostile lane detects omission.

adversarial_review.check: Could the partition upper bound be used in the wrong direction?
adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED: numerator lower divided by denominator upper is enforced.

adversarial_review.check: Could synthetic fixtures be relabelled as a source-owned active branch?
Can finitely decreasing log rows be called a uniform positive-mass result?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-REJECTED: only the liminf criterion is recorded.

adversarial_review.check: Can an exact zero-mass branch be conditionally normalized by this box formula?
adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED: positive volume is an explicit prerequisite.

adversarial_review.check: Does the interface replace T-054/T-059/T-061 methods or owner order?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: it is an additive R-464/R-465 consequence.

next_action: Obtain and hash-pin a source-owned active-branch embedding, measurable tube and energy ceiling; then instantiate the R-466 inequality with R-463's metric and test a branch-relative entropy/Jacobian compensator instead of repeating the full-dimensional proxy.
stop_or_redesign: If no owner artefact supplies the branch embedding and ceiling, retain R-466 as a finite interface and keep the branch-probability route parked.
If the branch-relative log budget diverges without a uniform compensator, record that obstruction and redesign only the normalization contract, not the established research method.
If a future owner changes the functional, regulator, volume, boundary, or limit order, issue a new versioned contract rather than mutating R-466.
